about: Source list for Settings > About > Licences. scripts/generate-licences.py reads it and writes Sources/App/Licences. A component with cores is shown only when one of those cores is linked (GAGA_CORE_SET); one without cores is in every build. framework names the core framework a component covers, so the test can check every embedded framework has a notice. docs/03 section 5 and docs/05 section 5 record why each part is here.
